caption: The drawing contains a rectangular decorative border featuring a complex symmetrical pattern comprising floral and geometric motifs. The left side of the rectangle includes a vertical panel with an intertwining ribbon design in red and blue, with five-petaled flowers alternating in pink and purple, each with a yellow center and yellow background elements. The main section of the rectangle, bordered in black, displays ornate scrollwork in red, gold, and blue, interlaced with abstract leaf forms in gold and pink, on a muted blue-gray background. Flower shapes with blue petals and yellow centers are enclosed in red and gold looping designs, and pink accent shapes fill open spaces. The title “Buckskin Mss Binding” is handwritten in black ink below the illustration, and a small number “48” appears at the lower left corner of the page. The overall color palette includes muted tones of red, blue, gold, yellow, pink, purple, and gray.
title: Plate 48: Buckskin Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
